metrics.quality_method: 5grams and full PG quotations measure literal echo only; paraphrase and environment require human qualitative review

independent_editorial_review.scope: Read-only comparison of four E Fati and six accepted roles with four D Fati and established A-D review. Not a code/install review.
independent_editorial_review.technical_boundary: Recorded E peaceful mission completed with four publications, no generation patch/reroll/provider retry. This does not cover Combat. UI redraw/toast issues remain distinct from successful generation.

comparison.D: D0 presupposed earlier disagreement and prior dispersion despite empty initial history.
comparison.E: E0 establishes marketplace, initial accusation and two speakers without presupposing PG questions or earlier dispersal.

comparison.D: D2/D3 answered uncertainty about current sheet and coins, without source custody facts.
comparison.E: E1 Daichi shows and retains sheet; E2 hands sheet and own money to Riuji, Keita money to Tamako; E2/E3 memory retains both recipients and distinct shares. No invented loss, reset or renewed ignorance of own belongings.
comparison.outcome: IMPROVED_OBSERVED; fiction only, not an inventory/mechanical qualification

comparison.D: Three replies had no shared five-token runs against earlier PG roles.
comparison.E: Independent normalization confirms zero shared five-token runs against all earlier PG roles and zero complete quoted PG sentences in E1-E3.
comparison.outcome: MAINTAINED; no numerical metric proves absence of paraphrase

comparison.D: No major role retelling; repeated NPC admissions remained.
comparison.E: Replies start from NPC answers and consequences. E2 acceptance of delivery/accompaniment and E3 movement answer actual proposals; they are not an improper restatement merely because subject matter matches PG requests. No substantial retelling of PG approach, posture or dialogue found.
comparison.outcome: MAINTAINED; a brief position statement at end E1 adds little but is not a reprise of an entire role

comparison.D: Motives and separate agency already present; later replies repeated admissions/limits.
comparison.E: E1 develops source fabrication, payment, motive and different responsibility of each. E2 adds actual delivery and condition of individual testimony. E3 repeats those individual declarations with little new personal response. Modes and tones are carried mainly by speech content and sparse gestures.
comparison.outcome: MIXED; rich E1, thinner later replies

comparison.D: Recurring vendor/customer/open passage function across four Fati.
comparison.E: E0 still vendor/customer/passage, but E1 introduces local crowd questions about payment and sheet, tied to the new revelation. E2/E3 return to generic passage, market work and background noise; material texture and independent ongoing activity remain sparse.
comparison.outcome: PARTIAL_IMPROVEMENT; environment not yet consistently rich

comparison.D: Admission, public correction, cooperation and actual place indication achieved.
comparison.E: Admission and public correction E1; physical narrative transfer E2; place reached/indicated and departure to report E3. No extra confirmation turn is required to complete.
comparison.outcome: IMPROVED_OBJECT_HANDLING; scene advances in all three replies

comparison.D: D1/D3 closed with explanatory investigative balances.
comparison.E: E1 still closes by telling what the discussion now concerns. E2 explains that confrontation leaves room for agreed follow-up. E3 closes with observable departure, but appends generic environment and repeats ignorance/individual testimony.
comparison.outcome: PARTIAL; explanatory habits reduced in final E3 but not eliminated

residual_findings.evidence: E1 already establishes both ignorance about payer and separate personal involvement. E2 makes separate testimony a condition; E3 reasserts it again and repeats ignorance despite no new question on payer.
residual_findings.effect: Final exchange repeats assurances while shortening actual response and texture.
residual_findings.general_correction: Keep acquired admissions and knowledge limits available privately; express them again only when a new question, contradiction, audience or consequence makes that repetition useful. An established agreement should produce its next observable act.

residual_findings.evidence: E1 ends by interpreting the current subject of the discussion; E2 labels the transition to agreed follow-up.
residual_findings.effect: The narrator explains progress already visible through acts and dialogue.
residual_findings.general_correction: Let the latest gesture, reply or movement carry the ending. Preserve investigative balances and pending questions in memory; do not add an explanatory paragraph to certify advancement.

residual_findings.evidence: Crowd questions in E1 are useful and new. Beyond that, market becomes repeatedly a narrow passage kept open with work continuing, including final E3.
residual_findings.effect: Place is legible but often interchangeable; it does not yet provide sustained depth.
residual_findings.general_correction: Give setting a small stable body of usable contextual facts and activities already in progress, with actors, materials and purposes. Select what matters at this moment, allow irrelevant background to stay implicit, and preserve actual changes. Do not require an ambient beat, clue or new obstacle every turn.

residual_findings.type: Richness uneven, not a word-count violation
residual_findings.evidence: METRICS records E0 141, E1 283, E2 137, E3 93 words. E3 completes the legitimate follow-up, but provides little new tonal/spatial differentiation.
residual_findings.effect: A complete technical ending is not automatically the desired editorial depth.
residual_findings.general_correction: Scale response to remaining choices, relations and meaningful physical consequences rather than to a fixed length. A brief congedo can be valid; avoid replacing substance with repeated assurances or decorative padding.

independent_editorial_review.recommendation: Keep E texts and history intact. Treat opening and custody as demonstrated improvements, preserve anti-echo behavior, and target remaining source/prompt weaknesses without new blacklists, quotas, mandatory examples, generation vetoes or automatic editorial rerolls. UI projection issues belong to a separate concrete fix. Further editorial or Combat claims require separately authorized pertinent play, not inference from this report.
